protocol.single_writer: Only the assigned agent may modify a listed file. The coordinator owns this ledger and resolves ownership changes.
protocol.read_before_work: Every agent must read this file before inspecting or modifying its assigned files.
protocol.status_updates: Agents communicate directly when possible. Otherwise they report past, present, and pending actions to the coordinator for recording here.
protocol.new_files: An agent must obtain a unique ledger entry from the coordinator before creating a new file.
protocol.cross_file_requests: An agent that needs a change in another agent's file sends the owning agent or coordinator a concrete request and does not edit that file.
